scope: Bounded successor routing-mechanism hypothesis. Separate from existing F124 autonomy-feedback PR #435. This freeze is created before any F124-R learner, experiment implementation, or protected confirmation.
negative_analysis: F123's dense Arm B captured meaningful public route causality in synthetic TRAIN but missed >=+0.05 superiority in Wingless; its workload proxy exceeded the single-route control. Posthoc F123 TRAIN diagnostics provide mechanism-selection advice only, not new independent evidence.
primary_hypothesis: A trainable sparse, query-conditioned, topology-indexed edge-state router with a hard two-state-per-hop budget can learn raw-token relational composition in competing public paths while reducing measured primitive operations versus the unchanged F123 dense-B architecture and surpassing the strongest eligible fixed nonlearned route heuristic on disjoint source families.

proposed_mechanism.name: Sparse-2 edge-state attention router
proposed_mechanism.optimizer: fixed deterministic full-batch clipped gradient updates with one seed and exact frozen schedule
proposed_mechanism.rollout: 3-4 TRAIN / 5-7 CONFIRM query hops; pre-index outgoing edges by public node and role; retain at most K=2 scored partial state hypotheses per step; trainable compatibility from raw 16-bit source/destination token interactions
proposed_mechanism.path_ties: Canonical hash of public observation-derived edge descriptor; no edge position, hidden truth, seed, chosen path, oracle, engineered equality indicator or precomputed route
proposed_mechanism.pruning: At every hop keep only top two finite learned scored edge-state candidates; all dropped and exhausted routes count as predictions, never selectively excluded from denominators
proposed_mechanism.learning_sensors: Public unsorted edge tuples, raw 16-bit slot tokens, public relation-role sequence, source and target only

controls.CTRL_F123_DENSE_B: Train the exact frozen F123 dense-B implementation with its same fixed optimizer/hyperparameters on the new F124-R TRAIN only. Preserve separate F123 original TRAIN pretrained-weight forward-only transfer diagnostic without treating it as fitted F124 control.
controls.CTRL_F122_NO_ROUTING: Exact frozen F122 local matcher and predeclared public lexicographic route selector.
controls.CTRL_FIXED_SOFT_PATH: Deterministic public approximate Hamming 12/16 path control.
controls.CTRL_ROLE_ONLY: Public relation-role traversal ignoring raw variable identities.
controls.CTRL_QUERY_ONLY: 20-parameter query/statistics learner, trained only on F124-R TRAIN.
controls.CTRL_EXACT_SYMBOLIC_CEILING: All publicly visible paths with exact raw token equality, information-matched symbolic ceiling, not an eligible learned comparator.
controls.CTRL_CUT_K_ABLATION: Frozen learned S2 with one masked/ablated highest-contributing retained edge; public information preserved and no label-directed choice.

environment.input_shuffle: Whole edges and arbitrary node symbols permuted label-blind; bit encodings salted afresh within each graph
environment.counterfactual: Positive and negative graphs preserve node-edge topology, edge role labels, token multiset, query, path inventory, and label-balanced distractor number; one true edge's token source swapped with an off-route token; independently exact-checked labels
environment.source_candidate_vectors: Exactly two distinct authenticated F118/F120 generated environment vectors per lane; immutable source candidate IDs, no vector changes after precommit

evaluation.primary: CONFIRM per lane paired correctness vs strongest eligible nonlearned public equal-information control; select S2 and thresholds on TRAIN only. Report all source candidates and all successes, failures, and stratum counts.
evaluation.resource_primary: Deterministically count complete public graph preprocessing, adjacency indexing, bitwise compatibility, multiply-add, pruning and allocation operations for every model and control; disclose wall-clock/runtime separately as secondary and do not compare incompatible raw proxy units as equal cost
evaluation.compute_budget_guard: Never silently exclude preprocessing, edge scanning, sorting, or branch pruning from resource count. Record timeouts, overbudget, and no-route as failures.
evaluation.interpretability: Report actual retained-path state traces, per-edge selection and soft attribution, positive/negative causal edge swaps, off-route null controls, and branch/depth strata.
evaluation.fail_classification: If either lane margin or resource bound fails, or any subgroup degrades, classify NEGATIVE/PARITY/INCONCLUSIVE; no acceptance.

qualification.gate_now: Freeze protocol and source-only contract validator only; do not simulate scientific success.
qualification.next: Implement bounded S2 model and new graph source family as one bounded delta, source-only TRAIN admission with specific negative tests; affected interfaces to exact F123 parent source, frozen controls, and custody.
qualification.finish: One new exact-head Ubuntu/Windows full Go regression, race, vet, build and artifact checks after implementation; no cached result substitutes final integration.
qualification.promotion: Not authorized by source tests; needs separately authenticated prospective first use and independent assessment.
